name: MR-Block / MR-AB-MIL
requirements_review: All five native MR models and five corresponding baseline controls; full200epoch AdamW/LinearLR per-update recipe, optional original VAL-CE early stop or last weights. Native merge flags/modes, nonlinear-training/linear-eval residual behavior, stochastic CATE VAL and predicted-label DGR center updates retained. Exact model/optimizer/scheduler/RNG/minibatch recovery and fixed TEST adaptation written. CATE requires actual aligned512D concept assets. Full source/wheel/native budget and current release gates remain pending.

execution_profiles.recipe: gated attention with frozen affine maps and nonlinear low-rank residuals
pinned native mr-abmil; AdamW5e-4/wd1e-5/LinearLR200updates; full200epoch budget and original earlystop selector; merge-aware exact recovery

native_recipe.early_stop_selection: minimum VAL CE, equal loss also updates selected weights
native_recipe.final_selection: last weights after final VAL, as original early_stopping=False

adaptations: patient-disjoint task manifest fixes split membership; few-shot eligibility is explicit input
TEST is locked; original train_fold constructs TEST loader and evaluates it after fitting
workers0, explicit runtime dependency pins and full numerical identity
immutable best and full model/AdamW/scheduler/sampler/RNG/minibatch recovery
native merged flags and module modes restored to avoid fresh-reload double merging
native_behaviors_preserved: original MR initialization, trainable bias, frozen base weight and rank64 nonlinear path
original eval linear merge delta even though training residual contains GELU
original CATE stochastic reparameterization even during VAL/evaluation
original MR-CATE trainer uses CE only; discarded IB losses are not silently added
original DGR variant updates centers from predicted class during TRAIN
